title: I gave snowballs guns and made a demo with Godot and Codex, looking for playtesters
author: PossibilityCivil9884
selftext:
hey everyone, I’ve been working on a game called Snowbody’s Safe and the first free Windows demo is up on itch

It started as a snowball rolling downhill and turned into an arena shooter where you roll around, grapple, pick upgrades and work your way through different weapons

The first player to reach the final weapon becomes a giant boss and everyone else has to take them down  
Your snow shell protects the heart inside, so getting damaged on one side means you need to turn and protect it

AI has been heavily involved in making this, mainly Codex for coding, debugging and implementing changes, with AI assistance on some visuals and audio too  
The process has been a lot of trying things, testing them and changing whatever feels wrong

Right now the demo is playable against bots and doesn’t require Steam  
  
Next is getting feedback and improving the movement, balance and first few minutes before moving toward a Steam release, no fixed release date yet

Looking for people willing to play a match or two and tell me how it feels  
Would especially like to know what’s confusing, what feels unfair and whether you actually want to play another match

Thanks

[Download the free demo](https://gremlinforgestudio.itch.io/snowbodys-safe-closed-playtest)

[Discord for feedback and updates](https://discord.gg/3RPUCmC6V)
